package profiles

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"github.com/viant/bindly/resource"
	"github.com/viant/datly/bootstrap"
	dexec "github.com/viant/datly/exec"
	gateway "github.com/viant/datly/gateway/http"
	"github.com/viant/datly/internal/testharness/sqlite"
	druntime "github.com/viant/datly/runtime"
	rhandler "github.com/viant/datly/runtime/handler"
	"github.com/viant/datly/spec"
	dsql "github.com/viant/datly/sql"
)

func TestGeneratedPostReaderExecution(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	db := sqlite.New(t)
	require.NoError(t, db.ExecStatements(ctx,
		"CREATE TABLE profiles(id INTEGER, category TEXT, name TEXT)",
		"INSERT INTO profiles VALUES (1,'a','keep'),(2,'a','omit'),(3,'b','other')",
		"PRAGMA query_only = ON"))
	resources := resource.New()
	const pkg = "github.com/viant/datly/postreaderfixture/profiles"
	for namespace, fs := range bootstrap.LinkedResources(nil, pkg) {
		require.NoError(t, resources.Register(namespace, fs))
	}
	cwd, err := os.Getwd()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	sources, err := bootstrap.DiscoverComponentsFromPackages(ctx, filepath.Dir(cwd), []string{pkg}, nil)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Len(t, sources, 1)
	component, err := sources[0].Resolve(reflect.TypeFor[ProfilesInput](), reflect.TypeFor[ProfilesOutput]())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	artifact, err := bootstrap.BuildArtifact(bootstrap.ArtifactInput{
		Component: component,
		InputType: reflect.TypeFor[ProfilesInput](), OutputType: reflect.TypeFor[ProfilesOutput](), Resources: resources,
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Len(t, artifact.Component.Routes, 1)
	require.Equal(t, "POST", artifact.Component.Routes[0].Method)
	require.Equal(t, "/profiles/read", artifact.Component.Routes[0].Path)
	reader, err := artifact.ReaderCompilation().NewExecution(bootstrap.ReaderRuntimeConfig{SQL: &dsql.SQLComponent{DB: db.DB}})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	registered, err := artifact.Registration(druntime.RegisteredComponent{Reader: reader})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	parent, err := bootstrap.BuildArtifact(bootstrap.ArtifactInput{
		Component: &spec.Component{Key: spec.Key{Kind: spec.KindComponent, Name: "Parent"}, Routes: []*spec.Route{{Method: "GET", Path: "/parent"}}},
		InputType: reflect.TypeFor[struct{}](), OutputType: reflect.TypeFor[struct{}](),
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	parentRegistration := &druntime.RegisteredComponent{
		Component: parent.Component, Input: parent.Input, OutputType: reflect.TypeFor[ProfilesOutput](),
		Handler: rhandler.HandlerFunc(func(ctx context.Context, inv rhandler.Invocation) (any, error) {
			value, found, err := inv.Binder.Lookup(ctx, dexec.ComponentInvokerKey)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.True(t, found)
			return value.(dexec.ComponentInvoker).InvokeComponent(ctx, dexec.ComponentRequest{
				Target: dexec.ComponentTarget{Component: artifact.Component.Key, Route: spec.RouteRef{Method: "POST", Path: "/profiles/read"}},
				Input:  &ProfilesInput{Inclusion: "b", Exclusion: "omit"},
			})
		}),
	}
	rt, err := druntime.NewRuntime([]*druntime.RegisteredComponent{registered, parentRegistration})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, rt.Shutdown(context.Background())) })
	handler := gateway.NewHandler(rt, nil, "test")
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, method, path, body string
		id                       float64
		fields                   int
	}{
		{"full", "POST", "/profiles/read", "{\"inclusion\":\"a\",\"exclusion\":\"omit\"}", 1, 2},
		{"independent body fields", "POST", "/profiles/read", "{\"inclusion\":\"a\",\"exclusion\":\"keep\"}", 2, 2},
		{"projected", "POST", "/profiles/read?fields=id", "{\"inclusion\":\"a\",\"exclusion\":\"omit\"}", 1, 1},
		{"child", "GET", "/parent", "", 3, 2},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			req := httptest.NewRequest(tc.method, tc.path, strings.NewReader(tc.body))
			req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			res := httptest.NewRecorder()
			handler.ServeHTTP(res, req)
			require.Equal(t, 200, res.Code, res.Body.String())
			var actual map[string]any
			require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(res.Body.Bytes(), &actual))
			require.Equal(t, "ok", actual["status"])
			require.Contains(t, actual, "metrics")
			rows := actual["data"].([]any)
			require.Len(t, rows, 1)
			row := rows[0].(map[string]any)
			require.Len(t, row, tc.fields)
			require.Equal(t, tc.id, row["Id"])
		})
	}
	res := httptest.NewRecorder()
	handler.ServeHTTP(res, httptest.NewRequest("GET", "/profiles/read", nil))
	require.Equal(t, 405, res.Code)
	var count int
	require.NoError(t, db.DB.QueryRowContext(ctx, "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM profiles").Scan(&count))
	require.Equal(t, 3, count)
}
